title: Revisiting unitarity of single scalar field with non-minimal coupling
summary: We have investigated the unitarity violation scale of a non-minimally coupled scalar field with quartic self-coupling. This model is widely studied in the literature but the estimation of the unitarity violation scale has not been consistently discussed, especially in the Jordan frame. We have calculated the six-point scattering amplitudes of the scalar particles in both the Jordan frame and the Einstein frame, and explicitly shown the frame-independence of the results.
